caption: Amphitheatre of Sutri, Sutri
composition: Elliptical Roman amphitheatre carved into soft tuff rock · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From above the camera looks down into the elliptical amphitheatre of Sutri carved into the soft tuff, its concentric stone rows curving through the left and center. The rough rock wall with dark niches rises on the right, trees crown the rim, and a few visitors walk the steps. The 11:47 sun is bright in a clear sky.
